commands.name: run
commands.summary: Mutate the code and run its tests against each mutant
commands.detail: DIR is the build, here unless given, and :MODULE one of its modules: as Gradle names it (:app), or as Maven's -pl takes it (:services/api). The run passes when the score reaches the threshold. A full run writes report files, keeps a record the next run compares with, and offers the commands to work on each missed mutant.

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Run one mutant's tests: it passes when they catch it
commands.detail: How a fix is proved: each missed mutant offers it as "done when".

commands.name: explain
commands.summary: Everything known of one mutant, with its tests run
commands.detail: Its card, the change in its bytecode, what its operator does, and its result in the last full run.

commands.name: ignore
commands.summary: Record a decision not to test one mutant
commands.detail: It goes in .mutastic/ignores.yaml with its line and the reason, to commit and review, and lapses when that line changes. --remove takes one back; ignore --prune takes away every one that has lapsed.

options.name: --threshold
options.help: The score a run must reach, from 0 to 100; 80 unless set

options.name: --since
options.help: Mutate only the lines changed since REF; the default branch without one

options.name: --only
options.help: Run one mutant; the run passes when it's caught

options.name: --tests-from
options.help: Also run this module's tests over what this one's miss: :app, or dependents for every module that depends on it

options.name: --workers
options.help: How many workers run side by side; half the cores, from 1 to 4, unless set

options.name: --confirm-catches
options.help: Run each catching test again on its own, to confirm the catch

options.name: --no-suggestions
options.help: Don't look for a test to suggest for each missed mutant

options.name: --report
options.help: A report file a full run writes: json, html or xml, or none; json and html unless set

options.name: --format
options.help: How the result is shown; full on a terminal, concise elsewhere, agent for coding agents

options.name: --vocabulary
options.help: plain says caught and missed; classic says killed and survived

options.name: --color
options.help: Colour: auto uses it on a terminal that wants it

options.name: --hyperlinks
options.help: File locations as links a terminal can open: auto uses them on a terminal

options.name: --progress
options.help: Progress on stderr: a bar on a terminal, counter lines in logs, none for agents

options.name: --reason
options.help: Why the mutant isn't worth a test: every ignore says

options.name: --remove
options.help: Take the mutant's ignore away, so it runs again

options.name: --prune
options.help: Take away every ignore whose code has changed

environment.name: MUTASTIC_AGENT=1
environment.meaning: The agent format, for coding agents

environment.name: MUTASTIC_VOCABULARY
environment.meaning: plain or classic, when --vocabulary isn't given

environment.name: MUTASTIC_PILLS
environment.meaning: Labels: square (the default), rounded (for a Nerd Font) or off

environment.name: MUTASTIC_ARID=audit
environment.meaning: Run the mutants the arid filters skip, and say what happened

exitCodes.meaning: The score reaches the threshold; for verify, the mutant is caught
A usage error, or a build mutastic couldn't read
The tests fail without any mutant
